title: Locality holdback policy and substantiation automation for private clusters
creator: Leah Rivera
description:
Problem: For customers operating in VPC/on-prem modes, automatic regional failover can violate contractual data residency or retention constraints. We need a 'locality holdback' control that prevents transparent evacuation of request processing to a non-compliant region unless strict gating and substantiation (evidence) are produced. This ticket defines the policy, runtime enforcement, and automated evidence packaging required to support safe, auditable failovers for private deployments.

Scope: control-plane policy language for holdback rules, node-agent enforcement hooks to refuse/mark requests for cross-region routing, an evidence snapshotter that captures a minimal, redacted bundle (routing decision, node location attestations, timestamps, KMS-wrapped keys, and hash proofs), retention settings for evidence bundles, and an export API + console workflow for auditors. Does not include full UI polish or enterprise billing changes.

High-level approach: 1) Add 'locality_holdback' flag to residency policies with modes: enforce | notify | auto-evacuate-with-evidence. 2) At failover planning time, evaluate policy graph: if policy == enforce -> cancel automatic failover and surface operator action; if notify -> allow failover but emit high-severity alert and collect evidence; if auto-evacuate-with-evidence -> allow failover only after evidence snapshot is successfully created and signed by node-agent. 3) Implement node-agent snapshotter that collects attestations (cloud metadata, TPM/HSM quote where available), request-level provenance (request route, model variant used, token hashes), and a compact redaction layer to remove PII. 4) Evidence bundles are encrypted with customer's KMS (or platform KMS for managed tenant) and pushed to audit store with immutable retention clocks. 5) Provide API endpoints for evidence retrieval and a one-click Console flow to export bundles for compliance review.

Non-goals: full forensic image capture, re-routing optimization, or expanding held-back behavior to hosted public tenants in this phase.
acceptance_criteria: Policy: residency policies accept 'locality_holdback' with three modes and are validated at write-time (schema + CLI + API).
Evaluation: control plane rejects automatic cross-region failover when policy==enforce and records a decision event.
Snapshot: node-agent can produce an evidence bundle within SLO (target: 20s) including a signed node attestation, routing decision record, and redaction manifest.
Encryption: evidence bundles stored in the audit store are encrypted and have integrity verified via signed digest.
Retention: evidence bundles respect per-customer retention settings and are ephemeral if retention==none.
Export: API endpoint exists to request an evidence bundle export; Console shows an export job with status and download link.
Telemetry: routing traces surface a 'holdback_reason' when a failover was blocked or gated.
